items.pos: n. 儲備 | v. 積存
items.colloc: maintain a stockpile 維持儲備 | stockpile supplies 囤積物資
items.distinct: inventory 庫存清單 | reserve 預備金
ex: The company needs to stockpile raw materials.
公司需要囤積原材料。
They built a large stockpile for emergencies.
他們為緊急狀況建立了大量儲備。
We must not stockpile unnecessary office items.
我們絕不能囤積不必要的辦公用品。

items.colloc: face a shortage 面臨短缺 | severe shortage 嚴重短缺
items.distinct: deficit 赤字 | scarcity 匱乏
ex: A sudden shortage delayed the production process.
突如其來的短缺延誤了生產流程。
The warehouse reported a shortage of parts.
倉庫回報了零件短缺。
There is a chronic shortage of supplies.
目前物資長期短缺。

items.colloc: replenish the stock 補充庫存 | replenish supplies 補充物資
items.distinct: refill 再填滿 | supply 供應
ex: We must replenish our stock before Monday.
我們必須在週一前補充庫存。
The manager will replenish the office supplies.
經理將會補充辦公用品。
They need to replenish their exhausted inventory.
他們需要補充耗盡的庫存。

items.colloc: warehouse manager 倉管經理 | store in a warehouse 儲存在倉庫
items.distinct: storage 儲存空間 | depot 倉庫/站
ex: The goods are arriving at the warehouse.
貨物即將抵達倉庫。
Our warehouse is currently at full capacity.
我們的倉庫目前已滿載。
He works as a warehouse supervisor today.
他今天擔任倉庫主管。

items.colloc: load onto a pallet 裝上棧板 | wooden pallet 木製棧板
items.distinct: shelf 架子 | platform 平台
ex: The staff moved pallets to the loading area.
員工將棧板移至裝卸區。
Please secure the boxes on the pallet.
請將箱子固定在棧板上。
Twenty pallets were shipped this morning.
今天早上運送了二十個棧板。

items.colloc: traded commodity 交易商品 | essential commodity 基本商品
items.distinct: product 產品 | merchandise 貨物
ex: The price of this commodity has increased.
這項商品的價格已經上漲。
They export various commodities to overseas markets.
他們出口多種商品至海外市場。
Market demand affects the commodity price index.
市場需求影響著商品價格指數。

items.pos: adj. 廢棄的 | 過時的
items.colloc: become obsolete 變為過時 | obsolete equipment 過時設備
items.distinct: outdated 老式的 | old 舊的
ex: These parts have become completely obsolete.
這些零件已經完全過時了。
The company replaces obsolete warehouse systems.
公司替換了過時的倉庫系統。
New technology made the inventory manual obsolete.
新科技使得庫存手冊過時了。

items.pos: n. 手冊 | adj. 手動的
items.colloc: operations manual 操作手冊 | manual labor 人力勞動
items.distinct: handbook 指南 | booklet 小冊子
ex: Please read the inventory control manual carefully.
請仔細閱讀庫存控制手冊。
The process is done by manual input.
此流程是透過手動輸入完成的。
They updated the manual for new hires.
他們為新進人員更新了手冊。

items.colloc: tracking number 追蹤編號 | keep tracking 持續追蹤
items.distinct: trace 追溯 | monitor 監控
ex: Use the tracking number for your shipment.
請使用您的貨運追蹤編號。
Efficient tracking improves our inventory accuracy.
有效的追蹤提升了我們的庫存準確度。
They implemented a new tracking software system.
他們實施了新的追蹤軟體系統。

items.pos: n. 日誌 | v. 紀錄
items.colloc: log the entry 紀錄入庫 | keep a log 保持紀錄
items.distinct: record 紀錄 | register 登記
ex: Staff must log every item entering stock.
員工必須紀錄每一件入庫的物品。
We checked the digital log for errors.
我們檢查了數位日誌以找出錯誤。
Every transaction is logged in the system.
每一筆交易都在系統中留有紀錄。

items.colloc: waste disposal 廢棄物處理 | safe disposal 安全處置
items.distinct: removal 移除 | clearing 清理
ex: The disposal of old items is scheduled.
舊物品的處理已排定時程。
We follow guidelines for hazardous waste disposal.
我們遵循危險廢棄物處理準則。
They need a plan for surplus disposal.
他們需要一個處理剩餘物品的計畫。

items.pos: n. 週轉率 | 人員流動率
items.colloc: inventory turnover 庫存週轉率 | high turnover 高週轉率
items.distinct: rotation 輪替 | flow 流動
ex: Our high inventory turnover indicates strong sales.
我們的高庫存週轉率顯示銷售強勁。
They are calculating the annual stock turnover.
他們正在計算年度庫存週轉率。
Increasing turnover helps reduce storage costs.
提高週轉率有助於減少倉儲成本。

items.colloc: scan the barcode 掃描條碼 | scan through 瀏覽過
items.distinct: read 閱讀 | copy 影印
ex: Please scan all items before shipping out.
出貨前請掃描所有物品。
The staff scanned the tags on crates.
員工掃描了貨箱上的標籤。
He quickly scanned the report for figures.
他快速掃描了報告中的數字。

items.colloc: reorder point 再訂購點 | reorder items 再訂貨
items.distinct: order 訂購 | purchase 購買
ex: The system triggers an alert to reorder.
系統會觸發再訂購的警告。
We need to reorder office paper supplies.
我們需要再訂購辦公室用紙。
They reorder stock when levels are low.
當庫存量低時，他們會進行再訂購。

items.colloc: resource allocation 資源配置 | budget allocation 預算分配
items.distinct: distribution 分發 | portion 分配部分
ex: Efficient allocation improves our warehouse capacity.
有效的配置改善了我們的倉儲容量。
They adjusted the allocation of shipping costs.
他們調整了運費的配置。
The manager reviewed the inventory allocation plan.
經理審閱了庫存配置計畫。

items.colloc: fragile goods 易碎品 | handle with care 小心輕放
items.distinct: breakable 可破裂的 | delicate 精緻的
ex: Mark the packages containing fragile items.
標示那些含有易碎品的包裝。
We use protective packaging for fragile goods.
我們為易碎品使用保護性包裝。
Handle all fragile cargo with extra care.
請格外小心處理所有易碎貨物。
